name: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
Combine sugar, butter, milk, and cocoa powder in a saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly. Boil exactly 1 minute — no more.
Remove from heat. Quickly stir in peanut butter and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in oats and salt. Mix well.
Drop heaping tablespoons onto prepared baking sheets.
Let cool and set at room temperature, about 30 minutes. Do not refrigerate while setting.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free butter and oat milk.
substitutions.vegan: Use dairy-free butter and plant milk.

notes: The 1-minute boil is critical — too short and they won't set, too long and they go crumbly.
